Hello @lebaphi 
one issue.

When  we first render the page, unread messages in Game Admin are shown in bold, read messages in normal.  But, when we "mark all messages as read" - I think the they should turn from bold to normal.

This is how they are shown on refresh.

So, I think we need to re-render after `Mark all as read`, IMHO.

![screencast](https://i.gyazo.com/75337d01a9d1dc51152b4402776e6afc.gif)

Great work so far guys! Hate to be annoying but I have two things to suggest:

1. The counter should be red, same as the counters for the message channels, to maintain uniformity and attract attention.
2. If I, as GC, send a message in the general chat, I shouldn't get an unread notification, since it's my own message. Instead, I should only get a notification when someone else sends it.

> 1. The counter should be red, same as the counters for the message channels, to maintain uniformity and attract attention.

Yes, well spotted.

> 2. If I, as GC, send a message in the general chat, I shouldn't get an unread notification, since it's my own message. Instead, I should only get a notification when someone else sends it.

_Hopefully_ we can do that :-)

What do you guys think about refreshing our notification counter? With all the new features we've added, I think a bell icon would fit nicely on the screen. Here's what I came up with: 

![Bell Icon Figma](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/85491794/159528845-128f867d-93bd-4c04-993b-d8c29ca11e26.png)

![Bell Icon Example](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/85491794/159529192-223aaacf-3fcd-4b98-95df-816a774afe52.png)

Very stylish @ShendMikullovci, but...

Personally I find the font-size an issue.  We also have an issue where users have so many tabs that they fall onto the _overflow_ menu.  I think we should keep the tabs titles as narrow as possible.
Ok @lebaphi - the only thing I think we have to do on here is to make the message-count red.

> Ok @lebaphi - the only thing I think we have to do on here is to make the message-count red.

yes sir 😁

Aah, it should be `9+` if we have more than `9`, please.

@lebaphi - this PR deletes this large bloc of code.   That's good news to me :-)

But, has this been replaced by new code?  If it has, I can't see it.

Hi @IanMayo, this block of code use to iterate over array of `messages` and recalculate `hasBeenRead` for each message. I think it's unnecessary because we already have a function `isMessageReaded` to do it. You can have a look at `MessagesListInsightsChannel.jsx`, code line 27.

issues.title: Insights/Game Admin Tab Notification Bug
issues.body:
Insights/Game Admin tabs don't show any notifications when new messages are received: 

https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/85491794/158014534-85516316-3f3a-4e05-b5a9-717b3204d391.mp4

It'd be nice to have a simple notification counter on both tabs that disappear once the user hits "MARK ALL AS READ".
